tex_content.html:
Let bounded Ricci--DeTurck flows $\hat g_1,\hat g_2$ on complete noncompact $M$ have common initial metric $g$, uniform $C^2(g)$ and bilipschitz bounds, and the same sequential $C^1$ asymptotics along an exhaustion. Then $\hat g_1=\hat g_2$.
